main_text.p: tributorum assertores, Motazali autem [?] Almoattali quasi dicas, Qui Deum attributorum ornamentis spoliant, appellarentur. Postea circa explicationem & interpretationem horum attributorum in varias itum est sententias, his verba prout sonant intelligentibus, adeo ut inter Deum & res creatas similitudinem statuerent, illis aliter rem explicantibus, vel dicentibus [illegible, ~3 words] &c. Novimus, dictante intellectu, nullam creaturam Deo, nec Deum ulli rei creatae similem esse, verum non novimus significationem verborum quae idem de utrisque affirmare videntur, neque nobis incumbere putamus, ut haec explicemus; sufficit ut credamus, & certo statuamus [illegible, ~3 words]. Non esse illi consortem, nec illi quid simile. Ex horum numero censendus Malec Ebn Ans, qui dixit, [illegible, ~5 words] * Sessio [super throno] notum est quid significet, qualitas ejus ignota, & eam credere necessarium ai interrogare de ea haeresis. Quosdam in [illegible, ~1 word] seu ut veram similitudinem affererent duces ait erroris habuisse illa Judaeorum sectam qui [illegible, ~1 word] seu Karraim audiunt, qui eo modo quae huiusmodi sunt in lege Mosis, intelligi volunt.
Inò coufque processerunt nonnulli — ut corporeitatem adstruant] Hi illi quos antea Alcai jassemies inde dictos vidimus quales inter Sephatiorum (c-tas[?]
* Quoddam de reliquis per [illegible, ~8 letters] dicta intelligi volunt.

page.notes: Arabic and Greek passages are only partly legible on the scan and are marked illegible where the letters cannot be read; the Arabic Qur'an quotation ("إن الله ليس كمثله شيء فلا يشبه شيا من المخلوقات") and the Arabic phrases after "Novimus", "Malec Ebn Ans" and "Quosdam in" could not be read letter by letter and are not transcribed. "Motazali" and "Almoattali" are the Latin forms of the Arabic names of the Mu'tazila and Mu'attila. The word "ai" after "necessarium" is doubtful and may be "at". The final line breaks in "(c-tas", which is the start of "sectas" continued at the foot of the column; the hyphen is doubtful. Margin notes: the Greek-marked note beside the "Sessio" lines and the reference "P.21, l.11." beside "Inò coufque".
